inspect: Rubies, sapphires, a few emeralds. Quill has them sorted by colour, then by how much the previous owner cried.
A silver bowl heaped with pearls, each one the size of a fat pea.
A velvet bust draped in gold chains and pearl ropes. It looks better dressed than most of the crew.
A little golden sea-captain with an enormous spyglass. You won it off a governor. He never did see it coming.
Silver plate and goblets, stacked with more care than the crew's own dishes.
A gilded looking-glass set with rubies. You look magnificent in it. You always do.
Two presentation swords, crossed. Neither has ever been used for anything but presenting.
A chest so full the lid won't close. Nobody has tried very hard to make it.
A spare crown, perched on a strongbox. Every hold should have a spare crown.
A tapestry map of these waters, a golden X stitched where you're standing. Mags did the X.
The treasure-room door, patched with fresh planks. The scorch marks are yellow. Scorch marks should not be yellow.
A brass telescope on a tripod, trained out to starboard.
Garrick's 'vessel': an overturned bathtub, drying out. The two giant sausages are drying out beside it. Nobody will say whose sausages they were.
The rowboat, freshly painted 'G.G.' on the bow. Oars shipped, water butt full, ready at a moment's notice. As agreed.
A belaying cleat on the foremast fife rail. The fouled sail's line is made fast here.
Salty Jim's pickled onions. The brine could strip paint.
A stoneware crock of something brining. It looks back.
A note in Salty Jim's hand: NO EEL PASTE. NOT EVER. NOT EVEN ON DECK. Underneath, in Quill's hand: 'Seconded.'
A painted board: a round little figure, crossed out in red. It is not subtle. It is not meant to be.
Rags and cloths on hooks, damp and ready. Everyone knows what for.
Mags's knitting basket: red and cream wool, and a pattern for something very small with wing-holes.
Your gold, filmed in yellow grease. It still glitters. It glitters wrong.
Coins, stuck together in a yellow paste.
Gold bars with a greasy sheen. Your fingerprints are now permanent.
The goblets have gone the colour of old tea. The candles won't light.
The golden idol's emerald eyes have clouded. It looks queasy.
The velvet cushion is damp. You decide not to ask with what.
A chest of gold, lightly steaming.
A small chest, breathing out yellow.
The strongbox held. The smell got in anyway.
The shields are tarnished to the colour of mustard.
Gems gone cloudy, like boiled sweets someone sucked and put back.
The pearls are yellow now. Several are sweating.
The velvet bust is stained. The necklaces are welded into one greasy rope.
The little golden captain appears to be holding his nose. It didn't used to.
Silver plate, tarnished yellow-brown in an afternoon.
The mirror has fogged over from the inside.
The presentation swords have rusted in the scabbards. In an afternoon.
The overflowing chest, overflowing with the same things, only yellower.
The spare crown fell in the Gust. It is not a spare anymore. It is a warning.
The tapestry map has gone sepia. The golden X is now just an X.
The chest Garrick landed on, split open. It is still breathing out.
The candles burn with a faintly green flame.
